notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. Financial figures are from the FY2025 Form 10-K (accession 0000070858-26-000157, filed February 25, 2026), checked against SEC XBRL; ownership is from the 2026 proxy (DEF 14A filed March 23, 2026, accession 0001193125-26-118929), shares as of March 13, 2026. LEADER: Brian Moynihan, Chair and Chief Executive Officer, beneficially owned 2,803,195 shares (including 38,376 shared with his spouse, footnote 8); the proxy states every director and named executive owned less than 1%, so pctEconomic is null. His 1,724,434 unvested restricted stock units are not beneficially owned under SEC rules and are not counted. HOLDERS: the proxy cites only the Schedule 13G/A filing dates (Vanguard January 30, 2026; Berkshire November 14, 2025; BlackRock January 29, 2024), not the dates the holdings refer to, so asOf is left null; BlackRock's figure rests on a 2024 filing and is stale. Berkshire's 568,070,012 shares (down from 680,233,587 in the 2025 proxy) already include the 450,665,500 shares (6.3%) held by its subsidiary National Indemnity Company, which is not listed separately. DIVIDENDS: the cash-flow statement reports one 'Cash dividends paid' line ($9,563 million) covering common and preferred; it is used as reported (the equity statement separately shows $8,083 million common and $1,445 million preferred declared). BUYBACKS: common stock only ($21,433 million, 452 million shares, including excise taxes per the repurchase summary); the $2,669 million preferred stock redemption is excluded. STOCK COMP: the note's $4.2 billion compensation cost is used; the cash-flow add-back 'Amortization of stock-based compensation' is $4,001 million. GEOGRAPHY: the 'Total Non-U.S.' subtotal ($15,410 million) is omitted to avoid double counting; footnote (3) says the U.S. row 'substantially reflects the U.S.'

branches.label: Bank offices (FDIC Summary of Deposits)
branches.period: as of June 30, 2024 (2024 Summary of Deposits survey)
branches.definition: Number of insured-bank office records (main office plus branches) reported in the FDIC Summary of Deposits for Bank of America, N.A. (FDIC cert 3510) and Bank of America California, N.A. (cert 25178), combined by the FDIC query, aggregated by branch state (STALPBR) by the FDIC BankFind API ('count').

deposits.label: Deposits held in offices in the state (FDIC Summary of Deposits)
deposits.period: as of June 30, 2024 (2024 Summary of Deposits survey)
deposits.definition: Sum of branch-office deposits (DEPSUMBR, reported in $ thousands, converted to millions) for Bank of America, N.A. (FDIC cert 3510) and Bank of America California, N.A. (cert 25178), combined by the FDIC query by branch state, as aggregated by the FDIC BankFind API ('sum_DEPSUMBR'). Deposits are assigned to the office where the bank books them, so main-office and booking-center states can be inflated relative to where depositors live.

footprint.notes: State rows come from two sources, so a state can appear twice with different metric keys: (1) FDIC Summary of Deposits, June 30, 2024 survey, aggregated server-side by the FDIC BankFind API by branch state for both Bank of America insured charters (cert 3510 and cert 25178, the single-office Bank of America California, N.A.); 'count' is office records and 'sum_DEPSUMBR' is deposits in $ thousands, stored in millions with a bracketed conversion. FDIC national totals for the query: 3,744 offices and $1,913,493,650 thousand. BofA has SOD offices in 38 states plus DC; states absent from the FDIC response have no BofA branch. (2) Bank of America 'Local Impact Fact Sheet' pages (resources.bankofamerica.com/local-market/fact-sheet/<market>) give 'Local employees'; only the 11 markets named for a state (AR, CO, DE, IA, KY, ME, NH, NJ, RI, UT, WI) are used; the fact sheets do not define market boundaries, and the other ~80 are metro markets. These pages are undated and current (2026). Wisconsin shows local employees but no FDIC branch offices. Not used: the 10-K states 78% of ~213,000 employees were in the U.S. at Dec 31, 2024 (no country breakdown, so no countries rows; the non-U.S. remainder would be a derivation). Sites are the four principal properties in 10-K Item 2.

paidout.notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (FY2025 Form 10-K, accession 0000070858-26-000157). Bank: operating cash flow (12,613) is driven by trading assets, loans held for sale and funding flows, so paidOut is null and altPaidOut = noninterest expense − D&A − SBC + income taxes paid. Interest paid (79,065) is shown separately. No premises-and-equipment purchase line, so capex is null. Revenue is net of interest expense (78,470).

CalPERS: the source is the information table of CalPERS's Form 13F for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, where the issuer is now named 'BANK OF AMER CORP' (same CUSIP 060505104). Form 13F covers only U.S.-listed securities, and the quoted row gives issuer, class, CUSIP, value in dollars and shares. The CalPERS percentage divides its September 30, 2026 shares by the Q3 2026 10-Q cover count at October 29, 2026, the same count used in the marketcap lens.
